examples.title: Rainbow sunburst
examples.description: Spokes and rings in HIRES, coloured by writing an ink code at the start of each band of rows, because on the Oric colour lives in the screen bytes themselves.

examples.title: Name in lights
examples.description: Type your name and the Atmos prints it forwards and backwards in each of its seven ink colours, with a PING for every line, then counts the letters.

examples.title: Ski run
examples.description: Steer down the slope with Z and X and dodge the trees; SCRN reads the screen to spot a crash, EXPLODE marks it, and SPACE skis again.

manuals.title: The Oric Atmos Manual
manuals.note: Ian Adamson, 1984, the edition produced for Oric Products International to ship with the Atmos; Extended BASIC reference; PDF scan via Defence-Force
